description: This file implements a liveness analysis for Torch JIT graphs, including a class 'LivenessAnalyzer' that computes variable liveness sets within a computational graph, handling loop counters and control flow structures.

classes.name: LivenessAnalyzer
classes.description: A class that performs fixed-point liveness analysis on Torch JIT graphs, tracking variable usage and loop counters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the liveness analysis until a fixed point is reached, returning a map of nodes to their liveness value vectors.

methods.name: insertExplicitUsesOfLoopCounters
methods.description: Inserts nodes to make loop counters explicitly live during loop execution.

methods.name: removeCounterNodes
methods.description: Removes nodes that were used to track loop counters after analysis.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current liveness sets for debugging.

methods.name: toSparseBitVector
methods.description: Converts a list of values to a sparse bit vector representation.

methods.name: toValueVector
methods.description: Converts a sparse bit vector back to a list of values.

methods.name: processBlock
methods.description: Processes a block of nodes to update liveness information, handling control flow structures.
